name: @rackbops/plugin-warbandeer
description: Warbandeer desktop-app character linking (/link, /unlink, ingest endpoint)

env.description: Port the ingest server binds inside the container; unset = connector off (never published to the host; reachable only through the Cloudflare Tunnel)

Compose hostname of the Cloudflare Tunnel sidecar in front of this port (the compose service is named cloudflared; a multi-instance deployment should use this instance's own tunnel container name instead, e.g. rackbops-discord-bot-debug-tunnel, matching bridge.url's own convention). Only a request whose peer address resolves to this host gets CF-Connecting-IP trusted; unset = the header is never trusted and every caller shares one rate-limit budget.
